behavior_confirmed.description: Whether the candidate operation is real and operative.

agent_relevant.description: Whether the operation implements an agent capability or lies on an agent-controlled path.

source_type.description: Origin of a value influencing the relevant effect; do not use a merely co-located input.

source_external.description: Whether the identified source is external or less trusted; config provenance may be unknown.

dependency_confirmed.description: Evidence strength for an external or less-trusted data/control path to the effect.

trust_boundary_crossed.description: Whether a proven less-trusted source or principal reaches a privileged component or external side effect.

effect_type.description: Primary candidate operation; process-spawn APIs are command_execution even if they invoke an external tool.

guard_present.description: Whether a security mechanism constrains the relevant path; timeouts and exception handling are not guards.

guard_effective.description: Effectiveness for the relevant candidate path; use not_applicable when no guard is present.

weakness_present.description: Whether supplied evidence supports a security-relevant deficiency.

vulnerability_status.description: Use not_assessed for material missing context and candidate only for an evidence-backed partial exploit path.
